# Backup Testing Log

Required monthly by the Backup and Disaster Recovery Policy, section 6. Keep for 6 years (45 CFR 164.316(b)(2)). Each test is also recorded automatically in the ClinAssess audit trail as `BACKUP_VERIFY`.
